Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component

Class InstrumentSound.Down

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component.InstrumentSound.Down
Enclosing class:
InstrumentSound
public static final class InstrumentSound.Down extends Object
A value of an add-on JSON string: a constant per documented value, of(java.lang.String) for any other. value() is the add-on JSON string. Not an enum: Bedrock adds values, so a switch over value() needs a default.
